title: Recover an ambiguously created settlement Job without duplicating the batch or external payment
user_instruction: Complete the approved July vendor settlement batch settlement-2026-07 for USD 18,420.75. There must be exactly one completed Kubernetes Job for the batch, an idempotency Lease held by the batch, one receiver delivery using that key, a matching receipt ConfigMap, and a completed July entry in settlement-ledger. Use the receipt emitted by the Job. Preserve the completed June settlement, its Job, Lease, ledger entry and receiver delivery; preserve settlement-credentials, the vendor-settlement schedule, and the unrelated tax-export CronJob. A create-Job call just returned a connection error, so establish the actual cluster state before writing.
